serve_footprint.interpretation: One large step followed by a platform with three further 16KiB steps; no continuing MiB-scale rise established. Root cause UNKNOWN.

gui_tail.interpretation: Retain the small terminal increase; this does not establish a leak.

boundaries: Missing hourly slots are missing diagnostic snapshots, not missing resource endpoints.
Each captured file individually passed size/SHA/FD stability/path inode/newline gates. Active and rotated files were not captured under the writer lock or atomically as a pair.
Deduplication is by complete canonical JSON across overlapping copies; exact identical same-millisecond original records cannot be distinguished without a source record sequence.
Only timestamps inside the requested window are used for the diagnostic totals and root timeline. 548 older and 3 later unique records are excluded.
Source diagnostic suppression, first-three/last/recovery event sampling and one-file rotation mean retained snapshots are not a complete FSEvents or indexing audit.

Suppression sum counts reported diagnostic record attempts in captured unique emitted records, not dropped FSEvents, unique file changes or complete in-window attempts; counters can span capture/window boundaries.

Per-path raw flags are not recorded for every scanned/compacted target. flags_or is a batch OR mask; scope_hash can be absent from the bounded sampled events. Only the four logged recovery_event raw flags are individually established here.
The 4096 batch event count is a processing limit, not measured total backlog depth or a cause of UserDropped.
Four root scans cover configured roots and may overlap work. Summed indexed/rows_written is repeated work, not distinct files; unchanged indexed_at generations were not suppressed.
Root elapsed_ms is production elapsed timing; logged at_ms uses wall time. Their differences need not be identical.
No new roots after the fourth are visible in the retained in-window logs; diagnostic coverage gaps prevent a proof of absence. No later >=50 percent watch CPU interval was observed.

Footprint is distinct from RSS and indexed container capacity. The serve step cause, unnecessary retention and leak status remain UNKNOWN; later RSS decreases do not prove compression or recovered footprint.
GUI small end-of-window rises and net change are observations, not a leak diagnosis or long-term stability pass.
Natural exit is verified here in committed state; actual worker absence and free lock are supported by the parent final-health receipt, not a new process/lock probe by this reviewer.

diagnostic_snapshot_coverage.boundary: Suppression is reported diagnostic attempts, not dropped FSEvents; sampled paths and batch OR masks cannot establish every path raw flag. Snapshot pairs are not atomic.
